segments.label: NEWS
segments.headline: Tesla opens Cybercab orders, by invite

beats.narration: Tesla is inviting select customers to buy a Cybercab, with no steering wheel.
direct: Tesla is inviting select customers to buy a Cybercab, with no steering wheel.

beats.narration: The estimated price: twenty-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety dollars. So what's the catch?
direct: The estimated price: twenty-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety dollars. So what's the catch?

beats.narration: Catch one: a two hundred ninety-nine dollar monthly Autonomy Subscription, first month included.
direct: Catch one: a two hundred ninety-nine dollar monthly Autonomy Subscription, first month included.

items.label: a month · Autonomy Subscription, first month included

beats.narration: Without it, Teslarati reports, the car won't operate at all.

beats.narration: Catch two: Tesla's post says personal use. Ride-hailing or renting it out needs Tesla's written authorization.

beats.narration: Catch three: it only runs inside Tesla's Robotaxi zones, which Tesla can expand or shrink.
